programme.title: RAZOR: Traces of China – Dragon Boats
programme.desc: More than just a race, dragon boating reveals the power of rhythm, teamwork, tradition, and human connection. In Traces of China – Dragon Boats, presenter Russell Beard explores how a 2,000-year-old Chinese tradition has evolved into a truly global sport. Through visits to British canoe organizer Mike Haslam, who launched the sport in 1981 as a lunch-hour curiosity, and German builder Andreas Stenkowitz, who transformed heavy teak vessels into lightweight fiberglass racing boats later exported back to China, the film reveals how tradition and innovation collided to create a global phenomenon. From breast cancer survivors who found healing in paddling to thousands of competitors across 33 nations, the dragon boat endures as a living bridge between East and West, a moving meditation on rhythm, recovery, and the unexpected power of an ancient craft.

programme.title: Headline：A Chinese village run by a CEO
programme.desc: In a Dai village called "Manluanzhan" near China's southwestern border, a full-time rural CEO manages the books and coordinates business operations at homestays, cafés, breweries, and other shops. But how to benefit from rural tourism without losing the village charm? In Manluanzhan, a fresh experiment is unfolding – one where villagers remain participants, investors, and decision-makers, but a CEO enters the fray to help defend their interests.

programme.title: Beyond the screen: how “film ” tourism and AI redefine moviegoer experience
programme.desc: As the Beijing International Film Festival takes over the city, films are no longer just something we watch in cinemas. They’re connecting tourism, retail, entertainment, and even cutting-edge tech. What does this “film plus” experience look like for audiences today? And as AI reshapes the film industry, what opportunities and challenges lie ahead? Host Xu Yawen spoke with Li Lun, assistant professor of economics at Peking University; Geng Ling, film producer and CEO of China Film Assist Company; and Teng Jimeng, associate professor of American studies at Beijing Foreign Studies University, to delve into these questions.

programme.title: Architecture Intelligence: Super bridge above the Yangtze
programme.desc: The mighty Yangzte poses a significant challenge for bridge builders. programme.title: Architecture Intelligence: When a skyscraper goes deep

programme.title: How rafting helped one village find new life

programme.title: RAZOR: Flower Power Mining
programme.desc: Every year, the world mines for billions of tonnes of metals. And the way we do it often comes at a huge cost to the environment. Nickel is one metal in huge demand as a vital component of electric vehicle batteries. One solution is blooming in an unexpected corner of the world in the form of a very special and unique plant called Odontarrhena decipiens. This is a type of hyperaccumulator, a plant which naturally takes up a large amount of certain metals, like nickel, from the soil. The plants are then processed to extract the nickel. The process, known as phytomining or agromining, is more efficient and less energy intensive, than traditional mining. RAZOR's Reya El-Salahi meets Professor Aida Bani, an instrumental part of Albanian phytomining research, who has dedicated two decades to studying this special type of plant. In Northern Albania a start-up is growing a stunning site of hyperaccumulator plants on a larger scale. Metalplant are cultivating 7 hectares with the aim of producing Nickel. They are also using enhanced rock weathering to make the process carbon negative.

programme.desc: Special coverage of China's annual sessions of its top legislature and political advisory body, known as the "Two Sessions".

programme.title: RAZOR: Flower Power Mining
programme.desc: Every year, the world mines for billions of tonnes of metals. And the way we do it often comes at a huge cost to the environment. Nickel is one metal in huge demand as a vital component of electric vehicle batteries. One solution is blooming in an unexpected corner of the world in the form of a very special and unique plant called Odontarrhena decipiens. This is a type of hyperaccumulator, a plant which naturally takes up a large amount of certain metals, like nickel, from the soil. The plants are then processed to extract the nickel. The process, known as phytomining or agromining, is more efficient and less energy intensive, than traditional mining. RAZOR's Reya El-Salahi meets Professor Aida Bani, an instrumental part of Albanian phytomining research, who has dedicated two decades to studying this special type of plant. In Northern Albania a start-up is growing a stunning site of hyperaccumulator plants on a larger scale. Metalplant are cultivating 7 hectares with the aim of producing Nickel. They are also using enhanced rock weathering to make the process carbon negative.

programme.title: RAZOR: Traces of China – Dragon Boats
programme.desc: More than just a race, dragon boating reveals the power of rhythm, teamwork, tradition, and human connection. In Traces of China – Dragon Boats, presenter Russell Beard explores how a 2,000-year-old Chinese tradition has evolved into a truly global sport. Through visits to British canoe organizer Mike Haslam, who launched the sport in 1981 as a lunch-hour curiosity, and German builder Andreas Stenkowitz, who transformed heavy teak vessels into lightweight fiberglass racing boats later exported back to China, the film reveals how tradition and innovation collided to create a global phenomenon. From breast cancer survivors who found healing in paddling to thousands of competitors across 33 nations, the dragon boat endures as a living bridge between East and West, a moving meditation on rhythm, recovery, and the unexpected power of an ancient craft.

programme.title: Headline：A Chinese village run by a CEO
programme.desc: In a Dai village called "Manluanzhan" near China's southwestern border, a full-time rural CEO manages the books and coordinates business operations at homestays, cafés, breweries, and other shops. But how to benefit from rural tourism without losing the village charm? In Manluanzhan, a fresh experiment is unfolding – one where villagers remain participants, investors, and decision-makers, but a CEO enters the fray to help defend their interests.

programme.title: Beyond the screen: how “film ” tourism and AI redefine moviegoer experience
programme.desc: As the Beijing International Film Festival takes over the city, films are no longer just something we watch in cinemas. They’re connecting tourism, retail, entertainment, and even cutting-edge tech. What does this “film plus” experience look like for audiences today? And as AI reshapes the film industry, what opportunities and challenges lie ahead? Host Xu Yawen spoke with Li Lun, assistant professor of economics at Peking University; Geng Ling, film producer and CEO of China Film Assist Company; and Teng Jimeng, associate professor of American studies at Beijing Foreign Studies University, to delve into these questions.

programme.title: Architecture Intelligence: Super bridge above the Yangtze
programme.desc: The mighty Yangzte poses a significant challenge for bridge builders. Let's witness how architects overcome this obstacle by constructing China's longest-spanning dual-purpose suspension bridge over this untamed river. Watch this clip of Tech It Out's documentary "Architecture Intelligence" for more.

programme.title: Architecture Intelligence: When a skyscraper goes deep
programme.desc: Beneath the bustling metropolises, there often exists an intricate underground network where access corridors and subway tracks intertwine. Have you ever wondered how it is possible to construct a skyscraper above metro lines without causing disruptions to the daily commute of thousands? Discover the answer in this clip from Tech It Out's documentary "Architecture Intelligence."

programme.title: The new keeper of the ancient village in the deep mountains
programme.desc: Deep in the mountains of Fujian, Yanxiang village is home to centuries-old Hakka architecture and an aging population. But a post 1995-born returnee is giving the ancient village a new future. Follow CGTN’s He Jingyi to see how a young village chief blends modern ideas with traditional heritage, breathing new life into this millennium-old rural settlement. #BizFocus

programme.title: How rafting helped one village find new life
programme.desc: In Sankengtan Village, Guangdong Province, a river that once flowed quietly through everyday life is now part of the Gulong Gorge rafting course—a global destination drawing millions of visitors each year. What was once a quiet rural community has been transformed by tourism, as local residents build new livelihoods around the river and the opportunities it brings. In this episode of BizFocus, CGTN's Vivienne Nunis joins those braving the white water to find out more.

programme.title: Inside the token surge: Where does the money flow in AI?
programme.desc: From "OpenClaw" to open-source AI agents, token demand is exploding. But where's the real money? CGTN x top AI experts on the AI gold rush, key players, and the inside track on where the money flows. Listen now.

programme.title: Meet China: Turning Villages into Stages, Taking Creativity to the World
programme.desc: In this episode of Meet China, we step into the frontlines of rural revitalization to see how a Gen-Z village chief is breathing new life into her hometown. We then visit the world’s toy capital, where Chinese manufacturing is turning culture and creativity into global stories. From a green beef cycle near Beijing to rice-prawn co-culture in Cambodia, this episode explores how technology, industry and cooperation are helping land thrive and livelihoods grow.

programme.title: Innovating at Scale: Behind the Scenes of AMNC26
programme.desc: Ahead of the World Economic Forum's (WEF) Annual Meeting of the New Champions, or known as the "Summer Davos" in Dalian, CGTN’s Michael Wang speaks with three key WEF organizers to explore what it takes to scale innovation in a rapidly changing world. This special discussion offers an exclusive behind-the-scenes look at how the WEF brings together innovators, businesses and policymakers to turn ideas into real-world change.

programme.title: The World Cup Economy
programme.desc: As the FIFA World Cup kicks off, the spotlight is not only on the field, but also on the massive economic opportunities unfolding beyond the stadiums. From tourism to business partnerships, the world's top sporting event is bringing people, markets and ideas closer together. But what does it take to turn global exposure into long-term growth? And what are the new trends shaping sports marketing? Join us on BizTalk as we explore the business opportunities behind "the beautiful game."

programme.title: Global Business-American Edition Ep.2
programme.desc: Global Business is the flagship business show of CGTN English Channel, bringing you the latest economic data, business trends and policies.

programme.title: Global Business-Asian Edition Ep.2

programme.title: China Bound：Xiamen
programme.desc: What's it like in one of China's happiest cities? Tianran is in sunny Xiamen on China's southeast coast, visiting the city's famous "island of music" and sampling local delicacies like shark meatballs, shacha noodles and fish in "soy sauce water". He'll discover former fishing villages turned hipster havens, drink tea with locals beneath traditional tenement buildings, and visit a student enclave brimming with creative startup energy.

programme.title: China Untapped: Changsha
programme.desc: The city of Changsha is one of central China's powerhouses. It's a leader in both the construction machinery industry and in media – Changsha was China's first UNESCO "Creative City". It's also one of China's best-known cities for its nightlife. The soul of a city is in its people, and this episode focuses on the women of Changsha who are helping to innovate, change and further develop this city they call home.

programme.title: Young drummer of Ansai
programme.desc: Soaring leaps and the energetic beats of the Ansai waist drum dance made Gao Yuchen, a nine-year-old boy, fall in love with the dance at first sight. Growing up in Ansai, Shaanxi, Gao was first drawn to the large-scale folk dance while watching a local performance. As a form of intangible cultural heritage, the Ansai waist drum dance was promoted by local authorities and was included as part of his school's PE program. Gao was able to receive waist drum dance training as an extracurricular activity at his school, and he subsequently became a rising star on campus. He says he wants to become a better dancer and hopes to perform on bigger stages.

programme.title: Foodwise: Huangshan Ep.1
programme.desc: Tianran and Hannah climb Mount.Huangshan, one of China's most famous mountains, sampling its delicate green tea and the rich flavors of Anhui cuisine, and explore the region's ancient villages and lush bamboo forests featured in the blockbuster film "Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon".

programme.title: Foodwise: Huangshan Ep.2
programme.desc: In Huangshan, Anhui Province, the hosts enjoy a cup of Queen Elizabeth II's favorite tea, as well as the oldest green tea to be exported Europe, and get hands on with quirky local delicacies ranging from "word candy" and tofu made of leaves, to the downright funky flavors of hairy tofu and stinky mandarin fish.

programme.title: All About the Yak
programme.desc: In this episode, we go to Nangqian, Yushu, Qinghai Province, to get close contact with the Yak in Tibet, which is known as the " Vehicle on the Plateau". During the bustling yak culture festival, people gather from near and far, meadows are crowded, and yak appraisal activities are also in full swing. As the journey continues, we are able to understand several aspects of the yak culture which is closely related to the life of Tibetan people.

programme.title: Seafaring Tales: Fu Ships
programme.desc: In past centuries, transporting goods along the Maritime Silk Road could be a hazardous undertaking. Ships often faced fierce storms which blew up on the high seas. To reduce the danger, China’s shipbuilders came up with a solution. They developed Fu ships, commonly known as junks, incorporating a special watertight bulkhead technology. Their revolutionary design allowed the ships to withstand the highest winds and roughest waters. The Maritime Silk Road was an ancient trading route that connected China to Southeast and South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. As a key passageway for trade and cultural exchange, it thrived for well over a thousand years, bringing Chinese tea, silk, porcelain, spices, and other precious cargo to the rest of the planet. The legacy of the Maritime Silk Road is still evident today in many parts of the world.

programme.title: Shenzhen：Before and Beneath the Skyscrapers
programme.desc: Episode 1 of Shenzhen: Past and Present of Shenzhen When it comes to Shenzhen, a pioneering city of China's reform and opening-up, people generally picture it as open, fashionable and bustling. Yet its history and culture are often dismissed as a "cultural desert" or merely a small fishing village. In this episode, we will take you on a journey to gain an in-depth insight into Shenzhen's history and culture.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Taiji Quan
programme.desc: Kleber travels to Chenjiagou in central China, the birthplace of Chen-style Taiji Quan. Also known as tai chi, the martial art is iconic for its slow movements and purported health benefits, but Kleber quickly discovers it’s the real deal: From being thrown around by teenagers to learning about the martial art’s Yin-Yang philosophy, Kleber experiences for himself how this kungfu style allows small to defeat big, and soft to beat strong.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Five Ancestors Fist
programme.desc: In Quanzhou, southeast China, Kleber seeks out masters of the Five Ancestors Fist, a combination of five local kungfu styles. He meets the abbot of a Southern Shaolin Temple, and takes part in the extraordinary training regime used by Shaolin monks to hone their bodies and minds. He experiences the intricacies of Quanzhou’s traditional puppetry, and learns how Five Ancestors Fist incorporated military tactics that allowed its practitioners to band together and fight off pirates.

programme.title: Living Arts of Huizhou
programme.desc: This is Huangshan in eastern China. In this city, you’ll encounter one of China’s most traditional building styles: Hui-style architecture. How does Hui style set this region apart? What’s life like for people living in these houses? With these questions in mind, we’re embarking on a journey to decode Hui-style architecture.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Taiji Quan
programme.desc: Kleber travels to Chenjiagou in central China, the birthplace of Chen-style Taiji Quan. programme.title: Kungfu-wise: White Crane
programme.desc: In Yongchun, China, Kleber explores the origins of White Crane kungfu and its effect on the martial arts world. He learns how its blocks and strikes were inspired by animal movements, and how acupuncture points can be used to deadly effect. After training his grip and finger strength with wooden sticks, he travels to Beijing for an introduction to Goju-ryu karate, and discovers striking similarities with White Crane.

programme.title: Fujian’s Tulou – The Mysterious Earthen Castles
programme.desc: The tulous, or earth-built dwellings, of Fujian are recognized as treasures of traditional architecture, thanks to their unique design, cultural importance, and embodiment of the concept of harmonious coexistence with nature. Tulous are mostly rectangular or circular in form, with a simple, elegant exterior and a well-furnished interior. As homes built by the Hakka people, they are imbued with diligence, wisdom, and the pursuit of excellence. Surrounded by mountains and waters, the tulous blend well with the natural environment. When building their tulous, the Hakka people pay attention to ecological balance in order to minimize their environmental footprint. A tulou is not only a safe place to live, but also the crystallization of the culture and architectural skill passed down for generations among the Hakka people.

programme.title: China Bound：Suzhou
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He visits Suzhou, a historic city in eastern China famously admired by Marco Polo. Crisscrossed by canals, Suzhou is renowned for its exquisite gardens, where ancient scholars recreated nature's beauty within their own homes. Tianran discovers a city of refined tastes, where even a bowl of breakfast noodles comes with unspoken etiquette, locals insist on only in-season produce, and foodies eagerly await the arrival of prized hairy crabs.

programme.title: China Untapped: Huzhou
programme.desc: Located in the east of China, on the south shore of Taihu Lake, Huzhou has been well-known for its richness in resources and blooming in silk trade since the ancient times. Guided by the concept of "lucid waters and lush mountains are invaluable assets", Huzhou now is committed to developing green industries. In this episode, CGTN hosts Tianran He and Hannah Wilson travelled to Huzhou, where they tried a variety of guesthouse hotels in the Moganshan Mountains; experienced the life of digital nomads in Anji’s countryside; learned about the eco-concepts behind China's traditional architectures in Nanxun Ancient Town; and explored the development of eco-agriculture powered by high-tech along the Taihu Lake. All these phenomena demonstrate that economic development and environmental protection can achieve harmonious coexistence, and that civilization thrives if ecology is prosperous.

programme.title: Young dancer of Batang melody
programme.desc: Tibetan girl Tashi Badro from Batang, Ganzi, Sichuan has learned how to do the Xianzi dance both from her mom and a school program. Batang Xianzi is a unique folk dance of the Tibetan ethnic group with a history spanning over 1,000 years on the Qinghai–Tibet Plateau. In order to keep the Tibetan tradition alive, Badro’s school has offered the dance as a cultural activity. Badro said dancing with her classmates is the happiest moment of her day. Watch the graceful movements of Badro and her peers performing the Xianzi dance.

programme.title: Foodwise: Fuding
programme.desc: The hosts are in Fuding, Fujian Province in southeast China for the Dragon Boat Festival, where teams of rowers compete against each other in narrow dragon-shaped boats. From making and eating zongzi rice dumplings to trying local street food, the hosts take part in the festivities before exploring the world of white tea, from visiting its “mother tree” to drinking it in a zen temple, and even feasting on a white tea banquet!

programme.title: Foodwise: Wuyi Mountains
programme.desc: The hosts are in the Wuyi Mountains of Fujian Province, the birthplace of oolong tea. Here they enjoy tea ceremony on a bamboo raft, feast on everything from smoked goose to lotus seed soup, and explore an ancient town that once sold tea to Russia. They discover that here it’s all about terroir, and that nestled within the cliffs of the Wuyi Mountains is the most expensive tea in the world.

programme.title: The Yak and the Nomad
programme.desc: Qinghai’s Yushu Prefecture is one of China’s key yak-producing regions. This trip took us to Nangqian County, where we explored the yak industry that lies at the heart of Tibetan herders’ daily lives. Trekking into the far-flung pastoral corners of the plateau, we listened closely to the stories behind the hurdles and hopes of pastoral life and development.

programme.title: Awakening Lion-1
programme.desc: Xingshi, or literally “awakened lion,” is a name for the southern style of the lion dance. Historically, it evolved from a court dance in the Tang Dynasty almost 1,200 years ago. With the southward migration of the population from the central plains, lion dance culture was introduced to the south. In the Ming Dynasty around 400 years ago, xingshi appeared in Guangdong and was then widely spread throughout southern China and even overseas. Lion dance has become a very important part of Chinese culture.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Wing Chun
programme.desc: Martial arts lover Kleber Battaglia is on a mission: To seek out China's kungfu masters, and learn their secrets. From explosive Wing Chun to fluid Taiji Quan, slippery Snake Style to elegant White Crane, he'll learn hidden moves and ancient techniques for defeating powerful opponents. But ?there’s more to kungfu than combat: From culture and philosophy, to wellness and insights from the natural world, Kleber will discover that contained within every kick, strike and throw, is the condensed wisdom of the ancient masters. This is Kungfu-wise. Kleber travels to Foshan, the birthplace of Wing Chun. A practitioner of this style, he seeks out masters of two different lineages: Ip Man and Snake Style. First he visits the Ip Man lineage, based on the legendary kungfu master whose life story spawned hundreds of martial arts movies, with Bruce Lee counting among his students. With Ip Man Wing Chun, Kleber learns how to create powerful short strikes perfectly suited to fighting in Foshan’s narrow alleys. With Snake Style, he experiences unique training methods that give its practitioners superhuman flexibility, allowing them to stick to their opponents, and even fight on boats in canals

programme.desc: Xingshi, or literally “awakened lion,” is a name for the southern style of the lion dance. Historically, it evolved from a court dance in the Tang Dynasty almost 1,200 years ago. With the southward migration of the population from the central plains, lion dance culture was introduced to the south. In the Ming Dynasty around 400 years ago, xingshi appeared in Guangdong and was then widely spread throughout southern China and even overseas. Lion dance has become a very important part of Chinese culture.

programme.title: Shenzhen：When Travel meets Technology
programme.desc: In the second episode of the Shenzhen series, we adopt high-tech aerial shooting and follow the host on a city tour, letting audiences experience Shenzhen’s vigorous development, lush ecological scenery and cutting-edge technological strength.

programme.title: Young dancer of Batang melody
programme.desc: Tibetan girl Tashi Badro from Batang, Ganzi, Sichuan has learned how to do the Xianzi dance both from her mom and a school program. Batang Xianzi is a unique folk dance of the Tibetan ethnic group with a history spanning over 1,000 years on the Qinghai–Tibet Plateau. In order to keep the Tibetan tradition alive, Badro’s school has offered the dance as a cultural activity. Badro said dancing with her classmates is the happiest moment of her day. Watch the graceful movements of Badro and her peers performing the Xianzi dance.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Wing Chun
programme.desc: Martial arts lover Kleber Battaglia is on a mission: To seek out China's kungfu masters, and learn their secrets. From explosive Wing Chun to fluid Taiji Quan, slippery Snake Style to elegant White Crane, he'll learn hidden moves and ancient techniques for defeating powerful opponents. But ?there’s more to kungfu than combat: From culture and philosophy, to wellness and insights from the natural world, Kleber will discover that contained within every kick, strike and throw, is the condensed wisdom of the ancient masters. This is Kungfu-wise. Kleber travels to Foshan, the birthplace of Wing Chun. A practitioner of this style, he seeks out masters of two different lineages: Ip Man and Snake Style. First he visits the Ip Man lineage, based on the legendary kungfu master whose life story spawned hundreds of martial arts movies, with Bruce Lee counting among his students. With Ip Man Wing Chun, Kleber learns how to create powerful short strikes perfectly suited to fighting in Foshan’s narrow alleys. With Snake Style, he experiences unique training methods that give its practitioners superhuman flexibility, allowing them to stick to their opponents, and even fight on boats in canals

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: White Crane
programme.desc: In Yongchun, China, Kleber explores the origins of White Crane kungfu and its effect on the martial arts world. He learns how its blocks and strikes were inspired by animal movements, and how acupuncture points can be used to deadly effect. After training his grip and finger strength with wooden sticks, he travels to Beijing for an introduction to Goju-ryu karate, and discovers striking similarities with White Crane.

programme.title: Fujian’s Tulou – The Mysterious Earthen Castles
programme.desc: The tulous, or earth-built dwellings, of Fujian are recognized as treasures of traditional architecture, thanks to their unique design, cultural importance, and embodiment of the concept of harmonious coexistence with nature. Tulous are mostly rectangular or circular in form, with a simple, elegant exterior and a well-furnished interior. As homes built by the Hakka people, they are imbued with diligence, wisdom, and the pursuit of excellence. Surrounded by mountains and waters, the tulous blend well with the natural environment. When building their tulous, the Hakka people pay attention to ecological balance in order to minimize their environmental footprint. A tulou is not only a safe place to live, but also the crystallization of the culture and architectural skill passed down for generations among the Hakka people.

programme.title: China Bound：Suzhou
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He visits Suzhou, a historic city in eastern China famously admired by Marco Polo. Crisscrossed by canals, Suzhou is renowned for its exquisite gardens, where ancient scholars recreated nature's beauty within their own homes. Tianran discovers a city of refined tastes, where even a bowl of breakfast noodles comes with unspoken etiquette, locals insist on only in-season produce, and foodies eagerly await the arrival of prized hairy crabs.

programme.title: China Untapped: Huzhou
programme.desc: Located in the east of China, on the south shore of Taihu Lake, Huzhou has been well-known for its richness in resources and blooming in silk trade since the ancient times. Guided by the concept of "lucid waters and lush mountains are invaluable assets", Huzhou now is committed to developing green industries. In this episode, CGTN hosts Tianran He and Hannah Wilson travelled to Huzhou, where they tried a variety of guesthouse hotels in the Moganshan Mountains; experienced the life of digital nomads in Anji’s countryside; learned about the eco-concepts behind China's traditional architectures in Nanxun Ancient Town; and explored the development of eco-agriculture powered by high-tech along the Taihu Lake. All these phenomena demonstrate that economic development and environmental protection can achieve harmonious coexistence, and that civilization thrives if ecology is prosperous.

programme.title: Secuestro
programme.desc: El secuestro es algo muy común entre rivales, pero cuando se escoge a la persona equivocada se convierte en un error que trae consecuencias drásticas.

programme.title: El pozo
programme.desc: Pilar no se comunica con los otros, vive en su propio mundo de fantasías, hasta que la familia toma una decision que cambiara el rumbo de sus vidas.

programme.title: El Despertar el Polvo
programme.desc: Una película que reflexiona, sin emitir juicios, sobre el origen de la violencia y da voz a los verdaderos protagonistas de un mundo marcado por el crimen en las afueras de la Ciudad de México.

programme.title: Concursante
programme.desc: Una comedia negra narra el destino del ganador del mayor premio de concursos de la historia.

programme.title: Cuernavaca
programme.desc: La historia de la mayoría de edad de un niño que luego de un hecho traumático es llevado a la hermosa Cuernavaca, donde tiene que encontrar a su padre mientras intenta adaptarse a la vida con su abuela, quien tiene sus propios problemas.

programme.title: Papita, maní y tostón
programme.desc: Los fanaticos del beisbol, Andres y Julissa, se enamoran y tienen que mantener en secreto el amor de Andres por un equipo rival del padre de Julissa.

programme.title: Paraisos Artificiales
programme.desc: Luisa tiene 25 años y lucha contra una adicción a la heroína. Después de escapar de la ciudad, se encuentra buscando reposo en un decadente centro turístico playero que se encuentra en las exuberantes colinas junto al mar de Veracruz, México.

programme.title: Voces secretas
programme.desc: La criminologa Marta Colombo investiga el asesinato de un conocido y odiado empresario. Hay varios sospechosos y nadie sabe si saldra la verdad a la luz o si se hara justicia.

programme.title: Vacaciones en el Infierno
programme.desc: Detenido y encarcelado en una prisión mexicana por tráfico de drogas, un hombre aprende a sobrevivir en este entorno hostil con la ayuda de un niño de 9 años.

programme.title: Colapso Global
programme.desc: El caos reina en nuestro planeta, llueve fuego del cielo y las personas deben matar para sobrevivir. Un grupo de habitantes de Pleasent, Washington, liderados por el alcalde, busca un refugio en un lugar elevado. Mientras la Tierra empieza a quebrarse, entre avalanchas, volcanes y motines, la caravana se enfrenta a un viaje por carretera en un paisaje postapocalíptico que nunca olvidarán.

programme.title: Cambio mortal
programme.desc: David Terran, un brillante científico, ha perdido su credibilidad a causa de sus teorías apocalípticas. Las explosiones nucleares en Irán tendrán graves repercusiones y la comunidad científica tendrá que confiar en David.

programme.title: Gun shy
programme.desc: La historia sigue a Turk Henry (Antonio Banderas), una superestrella del rock con discos de platino, casado con una supermodelo (Olga Kurylenko) y más rico de lo que jamás soñó. Durante unas vacaciones, su esposa es misteriosamente secuestrada por un grupo de piratas renegados sin barco. Con poca ayuda de las autoridades locales, Turk se ve obligado a embarcarse en una misión para rescatarla. Con habilidades más aptas para tocar el bajo, ligar y salir de fiesta, tendrá que enfrentarse a peligrosas selvas y a despiadados bandidos en esta divertida y trepidante aventura llena de acción.

programme.title: Esto no es un atracto
programme.desc: Dos chicos de instituto que no consiguen ligar son víctimas de una broma de dos chicas.

programme.title: El tren de la muerte
programme.desc: Un tren con rehenes es robado en Bremen, Alemania. Se dirige al sur de Europa con una bomba nuclear. Un grupo especial de lucha contra el crimen de la ONU se encarga de detenerlo en cooperación con militares y policías locales.

programme.title: Inferno
programme.desc: Mientras un hombre conduce su moto por el desierto, unos matones le roban el vehículo y lo dan por muerto. Sobrevive y ya no piensa en el suicidio, porque ahora tiene un objetivo en la vida: vengarse y recuperar su moto.

programme.title: County Line
programme.desc: Cuando el mejor amigo del ex sheriff Alden Rockwell es tiroteado, éste se ofrece como investigador privado para averiguar la verdad tras el tiroteo y descubre una conspiración criminal entre dos condados.

programme.title: Arachnid
programme.desc: Una expedición científica que investiga el brote de una epidemia vírica desconocida en una isla del sur del Pacífico se enfrenta a una araña alienígena gigante en la jungla.

programme.title: Ace Bodyguard
programme.desc: Esta película cuenta la historia de Zhang Han, un guardaespaldas de élite «retirado», que une fuerzas con su antiguo compañero para rescatar a su esposa secuestrada.

programme.title: Behewulf: la Leyenda Vikinga
programme.desc: Dinamarca, siglo VI. El rey danés Hrothgar y sus guerreros matan a un trol cuyo hijo, Grendel, jura vengarse.

programme.title: El joven detective Dee
programme.desc: China, año 665 d.C. La dinastía Tang está siendo amenazada por el reino coreano de Buyeo. Por ello, se envían barcos de guerra como advertencia. Sin embargo, la flota queda reducida a cenizas antes de llegar a su destino, supuestamente por el ataque del Dragón del Mar. La emperatriz ordena resolver el misterio de la desaparición de la flota de forma inmediata. El joven Dee llega ese mismo día para ocupar un puesto en el Departamento de Justicia.

programme.title: El bosque de los Sueños
programme.desc: El amor y la pérdida llevan a Arthur Brennan a cruzar el mundo para poner fin a sus días en Aokigahara, un denso bosque a los pies del Monte Fuji en Japón. Allí rememora los momentos más importantes de su historia de amor y restaura así su voluntad de vivir.

programme.title: Speed Asesino
programme.desc: Dos mejores amigos utilizan aviones de alta tecnología construidos por ellos mismos para llevar droga de México a California y financiar así su estilo de vida en Hollywood.

programme.title: El mundo del triasico
programme.desc: Los científicos consiguen dar vida a los dinosaurios para extraer sus órganos y salvar a los humanos. Pero cuando las criaturas escapan, los científicos tienen que luchar por sus vidas.

programme.title: L'Apocalypse
programme.desc: Alors qu’un astéroïde menace de s’écraser sur la Terre, Jason et Ashley recherchent en vain leur petite fille disparue. Face à la panique qui s’empare de la population, ils doivent garder la tête froide car leur temps est compté. Réussiront-ils à la retrouver saine et sauve avant la fin du monde ?

programme.title: Risen
programme.desc: Après l'explosion d'une météorite, une terrible contamination se produit dans une ville isolée en Alaska, ce qui provoque la mort de tous les êtres vivants dans les alentours.

programme.title: Incoming
programme.desc: La station spatiale internationale est désormais une prison - le site noir par excellence. Personne n'en sort. Et personne ne sait qu'elle est là. Mais lorsque les terroristes emprisonnés prennent le contrôle de la station et la transforment en un missile visant Moscou, seuls un pilote de navette et un médecin débutant peuvent les arrêter. Leur tâche est compliquée par un agent de la CIA véreux (Scott Adkins) qui a ses propres plans pour la station et les terroristes qui s'y trouvent.

programme.title: Age of the Dragons
programme.desc: Le roman classique Moby Dick de Herman Melville est recréé dans un monde où le capitaine Achab et son équipage sont à la recherche d'un grand dragon blanc.

programme.title: L'enfant d'Osiris
programme.desc: Dans une époque de colonisation interplanétaire, Sy Lombrok (Kellan Lutz), un ancien infirmier devenu vagabond au passé tourmenté, forme une alliance improbable avec Kane Sommerville (Daniel MacPherson), un lieutenant travaillant pour le sous-traitant militaire Exor. Dans une course contre la montre, ils tentent de sauver Indi (Teagan Croft), la jeune fille de Kane, alors qu’une crise mondiale imminente provoquée par Exor menace la planète.

programme.title: Desert Strike
programme.desc: Un ancien militaire au passé mystérieux conduit un groupe de réfugiés égyptiens à travers le désert et doit les protéger d'un groupe de mercenaires diaboliques.

programme.title: Special ID
programme.desc: Chan Chi-Lung est infiltré depuis des années dans le gang triadique hongkongais de Cheung Mo-Hung. Suite à l'échec d'une récente négociation menée par Lung avec les trois autres triades locales pour le compte de Hung, ce dernier commence à douter de son identité. Hung entreprend alors d'éliminer tous les policiers infiltrés de son gang, et nombre d'entre eux sont capturés et tués. Pressentant le danger, Lung demande à son capitaine, Cheung, de mettre fin à sa mission d'infiltration. Cependant, Cheung l'envoie en Chine continentale pour infiltrer un trafic de personnalités protégées . Ce trafic est dirigé par Sunny, le protégé de Hung et ancien camarade de Lung au sein du gang. Cheung promet de rétablir l'identité policière de Lung à la fin de la mission, une fois le trafic de Sunny ruiné. Lung accepte, accompagné de l'inspectrice Fang Jing et de son supérieur, Lei Peng, de la police chinoise. Mais avant qu'ils ne puissent atteindre Sunny, cette dernière disparaît soudainement, laissant Lung sans défense et en grand danger.

programme.title: Exit Speed
programme.desc: Dix passagers d'un bus se retrouvent bloqués dans une casse après avoir été chassés de la route par des motards. Pour survivre, ils doivent improviser des armes et avoir le courage de se défendre contre les motards meurtriers.

programme.title: Mega Piranha
programme.desc: Une souche mutante de piranhas géants et féroces s'échappe de l'Amazonie et se dirige vers la Floride.

programme.title: Blonde en Béton
programme.desc: "Trois colocataires fauchées, la vingtaine, survivent de justesse dans un appartement délabré. Mais un soir, leur vie bascule lorsqu’elles découvrent une valise contenant trois millions de dollars, au beau milieu d’une scène sanglante après un règlement de comptes entre trafiquants de drogue. Tentées de garder l’argent et de fuir le pays, les filles se retrouvent vite prises en chasse par des criminels chevronnés bien décidés à récupérer leur butin. Elles devront alors faire face à un ultime affrontement… et se battre pour leur survie."

programme.title: Le Meurtrier
programme.desc: Dans ce thriller d'action haletant, un chauffeur de taxi de Yanji, dans la préfecture autonome coréenne de Yanbian, au nord-est de la Chine, se rend en Corée du Sud à la demande d'un gangster local qui lui propose d'éliminer un professeur en échange du remboursement de sa dette. Parallèlement, il recherche sa femme, venue le rejoindre mais sans nouvelles depuis six mois. Ses soupçons d'infidélité le rongent, jusqu'à ce qu'un événement inattendu survienne cette nuit-là. Alors qu'il s'apprête à tuer le professeur, il se retrouve bientôt en fuite, traqué par la police et la mafia, donnant lieu à de violents combats et à d'intenses courses-poursuites.

programme.title: Never Back Down - La Révolte
programme.desc: Une femme est kidnappée et forcée de participer à des combats souterrains d'élite et doit se frayer un chemin vers la liberté.

programme.title: Force of Execution
programme.desc: Un patron du crime envoie son meilleur homme pour tuer un prisonnier. Il se trompe d'homme et en paie le prix. 6 mois plus tard, il est de nouveau sur pied. Son ex-patron se fait maintenant évincer par Ice Man, qui est responsable de l'affaire de la "mauvaise personne".

programme.title: Le Manteau de Chicago
programme.desc: Le Chicago Outfit fut le syndicat du crime organisé le plus puissant du XXe siècle, et Lou Marazano (Frank Vincent) en était le tueur à gages le plus redouté.Vingt ans après sa vague de meurtres la plus célèbre, Lou est devenu une relique : sa légende s’est effacée, son talent oublié, et ses heures de gloire sont derrière lui.Mais lorsque l’arrestation d’un influent représentant syndical pour fraude fiscale menace de révéler une vaste conspiration impliquant policiers, élus et mafieux, le grand patron du Outfit (Armand Assante) ordonne l’élimination de témoins-clés.Pour Lou, c’est l’occasion rêvée de financer sa retraite et de fuir Chicago avec sa compagne (Kathrine Narducci).Mais deux détectives tenaces (Danny Goldring et Stacy Keach) se lancent à ses trousses, et le parrain par intérim (Mike Starr) décide de l’exclure du Outfit.Lou va devoir prouver qu’il mérite toujours son titre d’homme de main le plus meurtrier du Chicago Outfit — un titre qu’il n’a plus porté depuis plus de vingt ans…

programme.title: Sonora
programme.desc: En 1931 en México, bajo la presión del gobierno de Sonora, un grupo de personas se ven obligadas a viajar a Mexicalli, donde se enfrentan al racismo y a otros peligros en el desierto

programme.title: Golia Alla Conquista Di Bagdad
programme.desc: Tra intrighi di corte, battaglie e colpi di scena, Golia affronta nemici e tradimenti per salvare Baghdad e difendere il regno. Diretto da Domenico Paolella.

programme.title: Proud Rebel
programme.desc: Un veterano confederado que vive en el Norte yanqui lucha contra el mutismo inducido por el shock de su hijo y el odio de los norteños.

programme.title: Golia E Il Cavaliere Mascherato
programme.desc: Tra castelli, duelli e congiure, Golia affronta nemici mascherati per difendere il regno e ristabilire la giustizia.

programme.title: Erik Il Vichingo
programme.desc: Tra terre nordiche e battaglie epiche, il guerriero Erik affronta nemici e tradimenti in una lotta per onore e potere, tra duelli e conquiste. Diretto da Mario Caiano con Giuliano Gemma.

programme.title: Cruce de Bastardos
programme.desc: Sigue la historia de Cam Talcutt, un hombre que ganó un puesto comercial en un juego de cartas.

programme.title: Zorro Contro Maciste
programme.desc: Tra duelli e imprese eroiche, Zorro e Maciste uniscono le forze contro un potere tirannico, tra azione e colpi di scena. Diretto da Umberto Lenzi

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.sub-title: Bonanza - S1 EP19 - Los asesinos a sueldo
programme.desc: Hoss y Little Joe son confundidos con sanguinarios asesinos a sueldo en un pequeño pueblo de Texas dominado por dos familias enemistadas.

programme.title: Cassidy Red
programme.desc: Cuatro de los forajidos más infames del Oeste llevan a cabo un audaz robo a un banco en la ciudad minera de Bath Water. Mientras la banda es perseguida por la ley, las cosas se complican cuando los bandidos descubren que han sido traicionados, pero ¿por quién?

programme.title: Giuseppe Venduto Dai Fratelli
programme.desc: Tradito dai fratelli e venduto come schiavo, Giuseppe affronta prove durissime in Egitto fino a diventare uomo di fiducia del faraone.

programme.title: Érase una vez en Tombstone
programme.desc: Esta película ofrece todos los grandes personajes que cabría esperar en una película sobre Tombstone. Los hermanos Earp, los hermanos Clanton, Doc Holliday, Johnny Ringo, etc. y grandes tiroteos. Lo que la película ofrece es una multitud de piezas del rompecabezas que completan la historia, no sólo acerca de por qué ocurrió el tiroteo, sino la historia real de lo que condujo a ella y lo que siguió.

programme.title: I Sette Gladiatori
programme.desc: Un grande film d'avventura con scontri fino all'ultimo sangue. Il gladiatore Dario, libero grazie alle sue vittorie, torna in patria. Qui, al posto del padre che vi governava, trova un tiranno usurpatore che l'ha ucciso. Con l'aiuto di sei validi combattenti, cercherà di rimettere tutto al proprio posto.

programme.title: Yellow Rock
programme.desc: Cinco hombres cabalgan hacia el inquietante pueblo de Yellow Rock, con la esperanza de rescatar a un familiar y a su hijo perdido.

programme.title: Maciste All'inferno
programme.desc: Tra inferi, magie oscure e creature demoniache, Maciste affronta una sfida estrema per salvare innocenti dal male.

programme.title: Sin refugio
programme.desc: Desde el primer momento en que el nuevo reverendo sube al púlpito, Liz sabe que ella y su familia están en peligro.

programme.title: Erode Il Grande
programme.desc: Tra potere, intrighi e tensioni di corte, Erode difende il trono affrontando tradimenti e scelte che segnano il destino del regno

programme.title: Il Vecchio Testamento
programme.desc: Dalla creazione ai grandi profeti, episodi biblici prendono vita tra miracoli, prove e destini che segnano la storia dell’umanità.

programme.title: 7 Winchester per un Massacro
programme.desc: Un pistolero se une a una banda de guerrilleros confederados para encontrar un alijo de oro confederado desaparecido.

programme.title: Sandokan Alla Riscossa
programme.desc: Tra mari esotici e scontri contro il potere coloniale, Sandokan torna a combattere per la libertà del suo popolo, tra arrembaggi e duelli.

programme.title: El Hombre de Utah
programme.desc: En un concurso de equitación, los malos quieren que John Weston pierda. Cuando éste se niega, añaden un seguro: una aguja envenenada justo debajo de su montura.

programme.title: West of the divide
programme.desc: Ted Hayden se hace pasar por un hombre buscado y se une a la banda de Gentry sólo para enterarse más tarde de que Gentry fue quien mató a su padre. Salva de Gentry el rancho del padre de Virginia Winters y también rescata a su hermano Spud, perdido hace mucho tiempo.

programme.title: Sandokan Contro Il Leopardo Di Sarawak
programme.desc: Tra giungle e mari esotici, Sandokan sfida il temibile Leopardo di Sarawak in una lotta tra vendetta e libertà, tra duelli e battaglie spettacolari.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.sub-title: Bonanza - S1 EP25 - Escape a la ponderosa
programme.desc: Tres desertores escaparon de una empalizada del Ejército a la Ponderosa. Cuando un capitán viene a buscarlos, Ben se da cuenta de lo que han tenido que aguantar y promete contarle la verdad a su buen amigo que está al mando de ese fuerte.

programme.title: Los McMasters
programme.desc: Cuando un veterano negro de la Guerra Civil se convierte en copropietario del rancho sureño de los McMasters, los indignados veteranos confederados locales vienen a por él y su esposa india.

programme.title: Il Magnifico Gladiatore
programme.desc: Diretto da Alfonso Brescia con Mark Forest, un gladiatore affronta tiranni e tradimenti in una Roma dominata dal potere.

programme.title: La Vengeza de los cheyennes
programme.desc: Cuando Charlotte Sutter es secuestrada por los apaches, su hermano Sam, ayudado por un viejo prospector borracho, va en su busca.

programme.title: La Vendetta Dei Gladiatori
programme.desc: Nell’antica Roma, un eroe affronta tradimenti e duelli mortali per vendicare il proprio popolo e sfidare il potere

programme.title: El Hombre el orgullo y la venganza
programme.desc: Un incondicional soldado español recurre a la delincuencia para demostrar su amor por una misteriosa y promiscua gitana.

programme.title: La Spada E La Croce
programme.desc: Con Yvonne De Carlo, passioni e destino si intrecciano nella Roma attraversata da grandi cambiamenti.

programme.title: Randy Cabalga Alone
programme.desc: Encarcelado por unos asesinatos que no cometió, Randy escapa sólo para tropezar con la guarida de los verdaderos asesinos.

programme.title: Giovanni Dalle Bande Nere
programme.desc: Diretto da Sergio Grieco,con protagonista Vittorio Gassman. Nel pieno delle guerre rinascimentali, il valoroso condottiero Giovanni dalle Bande Nere guida le sue truppe tra battaglie e strategie militari, diventando simbolo di coraggio e disciplina.

programme.title: Sagebrush Trail
programme.desc: Un hombre inculpado de asesinato escapa de la cárcel y se dirige al Oeste, donde se une a una banda en la que está implicado el verdadero asesino.

programme.title: Death Alley
programme.desc: En 1892, la banda de los Dalton se propuso convertirse en los forajidos más famosos de Estados Unidos. Este sueño se convirtió en pesadilla.

programme.title: Ettore Fieramosca
programme.desc: Nell’Italia rinascimentale, il valoroso Ettore Fieramosca guida i cavalieri italiani nella celebre sfida contro i francesi, tra onore, rivalità e spirito patriottico.

programme.title: Au-delà de la haine
programme.desc: Une famille de pionniers est presque entièrement détruite par des Indiens en quête de vengeance : Le petit George est laissé évanoui sur le sol, et sa petite sœur adoptée par le chef indien. Le destin les réunira à nouveau.

programme.title: Texas
programme.desc: A Dallas, un ancien soldat de l'Union tente de démasquer une conspiration de Sudistes qui ont assassiné son père, son ami et le Président.

programme.title: Randy le Solitaire
programme.desc: Emprisonné pour des meurtres qu'il n'a pas commis, Randy s'évade et tombe sur le repaire des vrais meurtriers.

programme.title: Un dollar entre les dents
programme.desc: Un pistolero solitaire tente de conclure un marché avec un bandit mexicain pour se partager un chargement d'or volé, ce qui donne lieu à un jeu de trahisons sans merci entre les deux hommes.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: Lorsque Todd Grayson, 16 ans, arrive de Boston à Virginia City, on lui annonce que son père a été tué par Ben Cartwright. Ben a tiré sur Luke Grayson en état de légitime défense, mais Todd ne veut rien entendre. Le garçon n'a qu'une idée en tête : venger son père en tuant Ben Cartwright.

programme.title: Black Killer
programme.desc: À Tombstone, un nouveau shérif s'engage à débarrasser la ville des hors-la-loi tels que les frères O'Hara, avec l'aide d'un étrange avocat qui se promène toujours avec deux gros ouvrages de droit sous le bras.

programme.title: Killer Kid
programme.desc: L'impitoyable et cruel capitaine Ramirez traque et tue les révolutionnaires dans sa quête du Saint, le chef vertueux de l'insurrection mexicaine contre les Fédéraux.

programme.title: Lola Colt
programme.desc: Lola, une danseuse de saloon, arrive dans la ville de Sant'Anna avec d'autres danseuses. La ville est cependant terrorisée par El Diablo, un hors-la-loi qui veut vendre les terres environnantes à la compagnie de chemin de fer. Lola aide les colons à se rebeller avec Rod, un jeune qui est tombé amoureux d'elle.

programme.title: Un bounty killer à Trinita
programme.desc: Les habitants de Trinity décident d'engager un chasseur de primes notoire pour les protéger d'une bande de hors-la-loi mexicains qui sème la terreur dans la région. Il découvre que le véritable instigateur de ces bandits se cache en ville. Une fusillade sanglante met fin à l'emprise de la bande et rend le contrôle de la ville à ses habitants.

programme.title: Furie au Missouri
programme.desc: Pendant les derniers mois de la guerre de Sécession, le frère de Joe est injustement tué par Clifford, un capitaine de l'armée nordiste. Joe décide de rejoindre un groupe de Sudistes déterminés à résister jusqu'au bout.

programme.title: La Charge des Cosaques
programme.desc: L'histoire de Hadji Murad, un chef tchétchène du XIXe siècle qui a mené ses guerriers dans une lutte contre les forces d'invasion du tsar russe.

programme.title: Un bounty killer à Trinita
programme.desc: Les habitants de Trinity décident d'engager un chasseur de primes notoire pour les protéger d'une bande de hors-la-loi mexicains qui sème la terreur dans la région. Il découvre que le véritable instigateur de ces bandits se cache en ville. Une fusillade sanglante met fin à l'emprise de la bande et rend le contrôle de la ville à ses habitants.

programme.title: Les Pirates du Mississipi
programme.desc: Un groupe de pirates menés par Kelly, un bandit habillé tout en noir, sème la terreur en s'en prenant aux habitants de Helena et aux bateaux postiers sur le Mississippi. Le shérif James Lively doit aller contre la méfiance des habitants mais aussi des Indiens. Mais avec l'aide des Cherokees, car les bandits se sont établis sur leurs terres, et de son adjoint Tom Quincy, il parvient à mettre fin à leurs méfaits.

programme.title: Le Rocher du Diable
programme.desc: Deux vieux amis se retrouvent dans des camps opposés pendant la guerre civile lors d'une bataille désespérée au sommet d'une montagne imprenable.

programme.title: Le retour de Billy the Kid
programme.desc: Billy the Kid tente de vivre en paix, sous un nouveau nom et dans une ville frontalière, mais il est approché par un prédicateur qui lui demande de l'aider à libérer la ville d'un homme impitoyable et de son tireur.

programme.title: Le Géant de Métropolis
programme.desc: Muscleman Ohro se rend dans la capitale pécheresse de l'Atlantide pour réprimander son impiété et son orgueil, et s'engage dans la bataille contre son seigneur maléfique Yoh-tar et ses plans hideux de super-science.

programme.title: Les amours de Salomé
programme.desc: Une célèbre ballerine viennoise fuit l'Europe pendant la guerre austro-prussienne et tombe amoureuse d'un bandit américain qui ressemble à son défunt amant royal.

programme.title: On m'appelle King
programme.desc: Un chasseur de primes traque une bande de trafiquants d'armes à travers la frontière mexicaine.

programme.title: Foodwise Ep.3
programme.desc: From the kitchen to the city, this documentary follows foreign hosts on an immersive journey—exploring the deeper meaning of what we eat, the relationship between people and food, and the connection between the places we call home.

programme.title: Zero Hour 1
programme.desc: As China sets its sights on achieving carbon neutrality by 2060, young people across the country are looking for creative solutions to help reach that goal. At Tsinghua University, students are learning to become stewards of the planet through research, policymaking, and storytelling. Meanwhile, students in Shenzhen have developed new methods for collecting and using rainwater, innovative grass-planting methods in Inner Mongolia are making China's deserts more habitable, and renewable energy is gradually replacing traditional energy sources. Perhaps the dream of carbon neutrality is closer than we thought.

programme.title: The Call of the Plateau
programme.desc: In Qinghai's Nianbaoyuze mountain range, 16 local herders—15 of them women—work tirelessly to protect endangered black-necked cranes and the wetlands they call home, even as the dangers of climate change threaten to undo their efforts.

programme.title: The Rewakening of the Grassland
programme.desc: In Qinghai's Nianbaoyuze area, Tibetan herder volunteers, government officials and experts join forces in the monumental task of protecting the plateau's ecosystems, spotlighting the community-based conservation efforts underway in this fragile highland environment.

programme.desc: Since the late 1970s, the United States has been warming faster than the rest of the world. From heatwaves and coastal flooding in the Northeast to droughts and wildfires in the Southwest, things are looking bleak—but there’s still time. Today, students and scientists are working to mitigate—perhaps even reverse—the worst effects of climate change. The question is: can it be done?

programme.title: Roaring With Pride
programme.desc: We get a first peek at the adorable additions in the denning enclosure. Lewa and Laili take their hunting skills to a new level and tackle a kudu, and we find out what Rae’s doing with hyena poo! Also, Kwali takes a nasty bite to the cheek. Can she hang onto her prize?

programme.title: Roaring With Pride
programme.desc: Penya and Paza encounter a python; the adorable cubs go on their first bush outing; Lewa and Laili keep the zebra on their toes. Meanwhile, the research team have more experiments for the Ngamo lions.

programme.title: Inhabit: A permaculture Perspective
programme.desc: Inhabit: A Permaculture Perspective explores the many environmental issues facing us today and examines solutions that are being applied using the ecological design process called "permaculture"; a design method and philosophy of life with great potential for solving issues related to agriculture, economics and governance. 'Inhabit' provides an intimate look at permaculture peoples and practices ranging from rural, suburban and urban landscapes. This beautifully made documentary presents a vast array of projects, concepts and translates the diversity of permaculture into something that can be understood by an equally diverse audience. For those familiar, it will be a call to action and a glimpse into what's possible. For those unfamiliar, it will be an introduction to a new way of being and a new way of relating to the Earth. For everyone, it will be a reminder that humans are capable of being planetary healing forces. Audience Favorite Princeton Environmental Film Festival 2015. Audience Choice Award EFFY Environmental Film Festival Yale 2015. Official Selections 2015: Food + Farm Film Fest SF, G2 Green Earth Film Festival, FICMA, Life Sciences Film Festival Prague, American Conservation Film Festival, Finger Lakes Environmental Film Festival, ITSA Back to Nature Film Festival & Crossroads Festival for Documentary Film and Discourse.

programme.title: Expedition Wallacea
programme.desc: In 1850, Alfred Russell Wallace investigates the island world of the malayan archipelagos -- and discovers that the nature there is separated into two parts through a mysterious magical border. A border which still bears his name: The 'Wallace-Line.' 150 years later, a new generation of investigators travel to the mysteries Wallace-Line to investigate under water. They dive down to a mystical world, a world in which Wallace was never able to get into. The investors want to find out if a 'marine' Wallace-Line exists.

programme.title: Wild Iberia
programme.desc: As the woods prepare to sleep and mushrooms grow as the first rains fall, flocks of cranes migrate home to Spain from their summer season in the north. The stags clash their antlers in pursuit of the does; there is little time before winter sets in.

programme.title: Wild Iberia
programme.desc: The unknown face of Spain. Snow, rain, clouds, and cold envelop the land. The ibex migrate to the valleys, and wolves patrol the mountains as vultures circle the skies overhead. Though the landscape looks bleak and barren at a glance, there is life thriving here.

programme.title: Wild Iberia
programme.desc: The sun heats the Earth, and life begins again. As they prepare to breed, animals wake from hibernation and build nests in treetops and caves. Whether reptiles, birds, or mammals, all the spring babies fight for survival through their first, most challenging days.

programme.title: Great White Shark - Beyond the Cage of Fear
programme.desc: Most people believe that the Great White Shark is a mindless eating machine. But what if we are wrong? In Beyond the Cage of Fear, a crew of scientists forms a relationship with a 2,000 pound Great White Shark named Bruce. They see through his eyes, swim with him, touch him and, in the end, they even attempt an experiment that most people would find absolutely crazy: introduce a Great White Shark to a real-life mermaid.

programme.title: River Jaws
programme.desc: Wells catfish! Over the last fifty years, it has colonised most of Europe's rivers - even the most polluted. This intruder has become the largest freshwater animal in Europe, and even hunts on shore.

programme.title: Pharm to Table
programme.desc: How far would you go, to know what's in your food? As we go about our daily lives, few of us stop to wonder what our food is really made of. Taylor Lancastor travels 2800 miles on foot, to defend our right to know, and discover the truth of what we are being fed.

programme.title: Mysterious Earth
programme.desc: Alexander the Great…Cleopatra, Queen of Egypt…Vlad III Dracul, Prince of Romania…the legacy of these historical icons live on in our modern day culture, but the mysterious circumstances that surround their deaths and conflicting reports of their final resting places have inspired worldwide investigation and unleashed a furious hunt to uncover the truth.

programme.title: Mysterious Earth
programme.desc: Ancient architecture stands as a lasting testimony to human achievement, a visual reflection of the cultural needs and shifting beliefs of civilizations at different points in time. Archeologists avidly study the ancient architecture of the past – temples, buildings and monuments – to reveal clues about the ancient civilizations that created them and understand how past innovation has helped shape the construction of our modern-day world.

programme.title: Mysterious Earth
programme.desc: The unexplained appearance of geometric shapes in various locations around the face of the Earth has baffled archaeologists, scientists and researchers alike. These puzzling designs form mysterious figures and alignments that suggest an important purpose, but leave behind more questions than answers, a riddle of origin that buries scholars under mountains of speculative theory and drives their search for scientific proof.

programme.title: Mysterious Earth
programme.desc: From the beginning of recorded time, humans have sought to understand the complex ecosystems within which we thrive and survive. The way we understand our physical bodies, the natural world that surrounds us, and our social structures has evolved over the centuries, and the evolution has been documented.

programme.title: Mysterious Earth
programme.desc: Despite its name, the Bronze Age is considered a golden age of civilization: an almost two thousand-year period – practically worldwide – of social and technological advances in weaponry and tools, culture and civil society. Its collapse is regarded as one of the worse disasters of ancient times – more violent and culturally disruptive than the fall of the Roman Empire.

programme.title: Xploration Awesome Planet
programme.desc: Host Philippe Cousteau examines the cause of volcanoes, earthquakes and tsunamis. We visit the Big Island of Hawaii, where there is still an active volcano. Then we visit a laboratory at Oregon State University that is able to simulate a tsunami. We'll explore the damage that these massive waves cause. Then we head to the Puget Sound in Washington and discover the history of tsunamis in the Northwest with the help of geologist, Brian Atwater. We'll learn if a tsunami will happen again on the west coast.

programme.title: Xploration Awesome Planet
programme.desc: Host Philippe Cousteau explores Yellowstone National Park, the site of a potential super-volcano. Fifty miles of magma lurks near the surface, and if it were to erupt, its ash would cover the earth and damage crops worldwide as well as our drinking water. Then Philippe visits Meteor Crater in Arizona, the site where a meteor once struck 50,000 years ago. We'll examine the damage it caused, and wonder if it could happen again. Then we travel to the Hawaiian Island of Maui, where powerful telescopes search the universe for meteors that might be heading our way. We explore the possibility of another meteor reaching our planet.

programme.title: Xploration Awesome Planet
programme.desc: Host Philippe Cousteau visits the Everglades of Florida and travels these waters by airboat to discover wildlife. Then we visit Yellowstone and explore this unique ecosystem that remains relatively undisturbed. We'll also look at planet Earth as one giant ecosystem, and examine the inter-dependency of all living things.

programme.title: Xploration Awesome Planet
programme.desc: Host Philippe Cousteau ventures to Mt. Washington in New Hampshire, a place known as the “Home of the World's Worst Weather.” We visit the “Wall of Wind” in Florida where scientists simulate hurricane force winds. In Colorado, we follow a scientific research team pursuing a tornado. We travel to Texas Tech, where they explore the destruction of debris thrown by tornadoes.

programme.title: Last Devils
programme.desc: Tasmanian Devils are the world's largest carnivorous marsupials and they are only found in Tasmania. Through hundreds of hours of filming in the wild, we reveal how fights over food are a carefully choreographed ritual, we witness the seemingly brutal mating process, see tiny young developing inside their mother's pouch, and visit wild devil pups play-fighting and hunting as they prepare for life in the outside world.

programme.title: Ten Deadliest Snakes with Nigel Marven
programme.desc: Nigel comes face-to-face with the Philippine cobra, the most lethally venomous cobra on the planet. And in deep, dark caves on Palawan Island, the presenter searches for giant reticulated pythons sheltering from the heat of the day.

programme.title: Ten Deadliest Snakes with Nigel Marven
programme.desc: Infra-red cameras in the dead of night reveals a forest pit-viper sense and strike a target just fractionally warmer than its surroundings. Then there's the mussurana - a snake that not only eats other snakes but is immune to their venom.

programme.title: Ten Deadliest Snakes with Nigel Marven
programme.desc: In the tunnels of a leafcutter ant nest, we uncover a Central American coral snake sharing the burrow. Nigel meets a rattlesnake without a rattle, and a young Mexican cantil uses its white tail tip to attract prey close for a deadly strike.

programme.title: Ten Deadliest Snakes with Nigel Marven
programme.desc: Snakes are highly-adapted to survive in the scorching deserts of Arabia, and Nigel's skills are tested to find his top ten. Will the saw-scaled viper's venom and lightning reflexes be a match for the backwards strike of the puff adder?

programme.title: Africa: The Serengeti
programme.desc: Chronicles a spectacle that few humans have ever witnessed, the Great Migration, taking viewers on a journey with over 1.5 million animals as they travel more than 500 miles across the Serengeti plains in Tanzania and Kenya.

programme.title: Dinosaurs Alive!
programme.desc: See the earliest creatures of the Triassic Period to the monsters of the Cretaceous in a 'life-sized' giant screen presentation. Join renowned paleontologists as they discover new fossils and uncover evidence that dinosaur descendants are still among us. Realistic and scientifically-accurate computer generated animation brings dinosaurs back to life -- in a big way!

programme.title: Wonders of the Arctic
programme.desc: Our ongoing quest to explore and come to terms with the Arctic is presented in the context of the crucial role that ice plays in the north. Ice is to the Arctic as trees are to the rainforest.

programme.title: Sea Lions: Life by a Whisker
programme.desc: Between a jagged cliff face and a roaring ocean, lives a colony of Australian Sea Lions. In an environment equally as harsh as it is beautiful, be immersed in a classic coming of age tale guided by one of Australia's most unique, intelligent, and playful animals. Take an intimate journey inside the colony where a life of great intimacy, tenderness, and clumsiness, must often give way to a life of great sacrifice and bravery. Dive into the world of a rare Australian Sea Lion pup - and meet the people that are trying to save her species.

programme.title: Roaring With Pride
programme.desc: The lions are on the hunt for giraffe. Meanwhile, researcher Rae accompanies the lions as they encounter nervy hartebeest. The game capture unit are tasked with supplying more zebra for the Ngama release site. And don’t miss the action as hungry Kwali zones in on an unsuspecting zebra. But can she hold on?

programme.title: Roaring With Pride
programme.desc: Phyre has to be darted to keep the balance in the pride healthy, while Pazza shows off her highly possessive nature with an unsuspecting tortoise. And Milo demonstrates why he wears the pants around here.

programme.title: Roaring With Pride
programme.desc: We follow the as they walk and stalk. Meat preparation gets weird for some as our volunteers make dinner time more interesting. A brave zebra stallion takes the fight to the ever confident lions. A historical moment is notched up for Wakanaka as she proves her predatory prowess.

programme.title: Marge d'Erreur
programme.desc: Rebecca (Anny Duperey), avocate, réalise que le jeune homme (Julien Crampon) qu'elle a disculpé après une brillante défense pourrait bien être le coupable du meurtre dont il est accusé, et qu'il prépare peut-être un autre crime....

programme.title: Suspicion
programme.desc: Catherine rencontre Nick, un veuf, qu'elle épouse et avec qui elle emménage. Des choses étranges commencent à lui arriver dans son appartement. Est-elle en train de l'imaginer ou...

programme.title: Présomption d'innocence
programme.desc: Une femme est reconnue coupable d'avoir tué son petit ami et sa meilleure amie dans le feu de la passion bien qu'elle ait été défendue par un avocat de renom. Elle s'enfuit après le procès afin de découvrir qui l'a piégée.

programme.title: Never Let Go
programme.desc: Une mère célibataire en vacances fait appel à la justice pour récupérer son enfant enlevé.

programme.title: Planning for joy (fr)
programme.desc: Alors que Claudia porte la robe de demoiselle d'honneur porte-bonheur qui a permis à toutes ses amies de se marier, elle se rend compte qu'elle cherchait l'amour au mauvais endroit.

programme.title: Le Ravisseur
programme.desc: Lorsqu'un policier apparemment exemplaire enlève et emprisonne secrètement une belle danseuse, une bataille mortelle s'engage entre le ravisseur et la captive.

programme.title: Coldwater
programme.desc: À Paris au XVIIe siècle, un élégant bretteur nommé D'Artagnan se retrouve opposé aux puissantes forces qui prennent le contrôle de la France. Il part venger le meurtre de ses parents et découvre un pays déchiré par le chaos et les troubles civils. Son cœur ne s’adoucit que pour Francesca, une fougueuse paysanne qui conquiert D'Artagnan au premier regard.

programme.title: La mémoire de mon pays
programme.desc: Langston Whitfield est journaliste au Washington Post. Son rédacteur en chef l’envoie en Afrique du Sud pour couvrir les audiences de la Commission Vérité et Réconciliation, où les auteurs de meurtres et de tortures des deux camps durant l’Apartheid sont invités à se présenter et à affronter leurs victimes. En disant la vérité sans fard et en exprimant des remords, ils peuvent obtenir l’amnistie. Les profondes blessures de l’Apartheid peuvent-elles être guéries par la réconciliation ?

programme.title: Deadly Ruphoria
programme.desc: Une rare soirée entre amies tourne au cauchemar pour Shana Jones, étudiante à l’université, lorsque Romeon Kingston, chef d’un réseau de traite des êtres humains, jette son dévolu sur elle.

programme.title: Supernova
programme.desc: Sam et Tusker voyagent à travers l'Angleterre dans leur vieux camping-car pour voir leurs amis, leur famille et des lieux du passé. Depuis le diagnostic de démence de Tusker, leur temps ensemble le plus précieux de tous.

programme.title: WELCOME BACK, MISS MARY
programme.desc: Joey Vitello, un jeune homme de vingt ans sans but, vit toujours chez ses parents au sein de sa famille italo-américaine haute en couleur. Il retrouve Mary O'Callahan, une camarade d’enfance autrefois surnommée Mary la Terrifiante . Celle qui était un vilain petit canard est devenue une beauté irrésistible, de retour dans le quartier après avoir vaincu un cancer. Lorsque Joey découvre que sa guérison est due à un miracle, leur amitié se transforme en romance, et Mary l’initie à la foi. Les nouvelles convictions de Joey bouleversent la foi de sa famille, et le chaos s’installe alors que chacun part à la recherche de son propre miracle.

programme.title: N'oubliez Jamais
programme.desc: Un homme (Phillips) qui se réveille amnésique découvre également que son soi-disant ami l'a accusé de meurtre.

programme.title: La vie selon Gus Orviston
programme.desc: Un jeune homme abandonne sa famille pour mener une vie solitaire consacrée à la pêche à la mouche. Son objectif était de trouver sa propre voie dans le monde de la pêche et ainsi se découvrir lui-même et trouver l'amour.

programme.title: The Tracker
programme.desc: Spears, détective privé basé à Los Angeles, apprend que son ex, Kim, s'est fait kidnapper par la Mafia Chinoise. Alors qu'il ne souhaite pas s'mpliquer, ses sentiments pour Kim le poussent à retourner à New York pour la sauver.

programme.title: Resort Paraíso

La desesperación les lleva a ocupar el hotel en el que Eva trabaja en verano y que cierra entre los meses de noviembre y marzo, aprovechando las habitaciones y distintas dependencias del resort para pasar el invierno.

programme.title: Dulcinea

programme.title: Mujeres De Coque Malla
programme.desc: Coque Malla se reúne con varias artistas femeninas durante el proceso creativo de su nuevo trabajo musical. Ensayos intimistas, confidencias, complicidad y pasión creativa que culmina con la grabación del disco ´Mujeres´.

programme.title: La Rusa
programme.desc: Tito es un hombre cerca de los 50. En plena crisis personal, decide volver a su pueblo, del que se fue hace más de 15 años, con la intención de poner en orden lo poco que le queda, su casa. Cuando llega se encuentra un pueblo sombrío sometido al abuso de Los Crespo.

programme.title: Lejos Del Fuego
programme.desc: Después de un año sin verse, Palo y sus amigas se reúnen en una casa en el campo para ponerse al día e intentar recuperar su amistad. Lejos de las diferencias que las distanciaron en el pasado. Lejos del caos de la ciudad. Lejos del fuego.

programme.title: Los Amores Cobardes
programme.desc: Eva, una joven e independiente dibujante, vuelve a Málaga para el verano y se encuentra con su ex Rubén, al que no había visto desde que rompieron todo contacto hace 6 años.

programme.title: La Isla Interior
